vibe: Aggressive, heavy, dominant, occult, retro terminal, dark synth
rules: Everything is text/ASCII. No images, no gradients except for text shadow glows.
Lighting is FAKE and driven by character density. '█' is blindingly bright, '.' is barely visible in the dark abyss.
Movement is rhythmic, heavy, breathing. It carries weight. It sways in harmony rather than chaotic flickering.
The Grid is Absolute. To solve mismatched character sizes, every character sits perfectly centered in a fixed terminal cell. This creates mechanical order out of demonic chaos.
Symmetry is divine. Symmetrical structures imply cults, altars, and artificial intelligence.
